name: training-app
description: Training App — self-hosted Garmin-synced training calendar with admin-created accounts for a few friends.

scripts.test: cd backend && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests
scripts.lint: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app tests && cd .. && prettier --check "backend/frontend/js/**/*.js"
scripts.format: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check --fix app tests && cd .. && prettier --write "backend/frontend/js/**/*.js"
